title: Essential Vocabulary: Introduce Yourself
description: Learn basic English words and greeting phrases to introduce yourself confidently.

vocabulary.example: Let me introduce myself. My name is Nam.
What is your occupation? I am a student.

grammar.point: Verb TO BE (am/is/are) in Simple Present
grammar.explanation: Dùng để giới thiệu tên, tuổi, quốc tịch, nghề nghiệp.

reading.title: Meet Huy
reading.content: Hello! My name is Huy. I am nineteen years old. I live in Ho Chi Minh City. I am a student at the university. My major is computer science. In my free time, I like reading books and playing football. I want to learn English to get a good job in the future.

essayPrompt: Write a short paragraph (50-80 words) introducing yourself, including your name, age, city, and hobbies.

title: Practical Grammar: Present Perfect vs Simple Past
description: Master the distinction between activities completed in the past and those connected to the present.

vocabulary.example: Travelling gives you valuable life experiences.
The country is making a transition to renewable energy.
She accomplished her goals after years of hard work.

grammar.explanation: Simple Past dùng cho hành động bắt đầu và kết thúc hoàn toàn trong quá khứ. Present Perfect dùng cho hành động xảy ra trong quá khứ kéo dài đến hiện tại hoặc có kết quả liên quan ở hiện tại.
structures: Simple Past: S + V2/ed (I went to Hanoi last year.)
Present Perfect: S + have/has + V3/ed (I have lived here for 5 years.)

reading.title: A Journey of Career Transition
reading.content: Minh has been a tour guide in Da Nang for three years. However, last month, he decided to transition into a coffee shop manager in Da Lat. He has already designed two signature drinks. Yesterday, he successfully opened his small shop in the valley. Although he faced some minor opening day difficulties, he fixed them quickly. He believes that passionate work is the key to accomplishing career happiness in life.

questions.question: How long has Minh worked as a tour guide?
What did Minh accomplish yesterday?
options: Opened his small coffee shop in the valley
questions.answer: Opened his small coffee shop in the valley

essayPrompt: Write a paragraph (100-150 words) describing a major transition or experience in your career or education. Explain what you have accomplished so far.

title: Advanced Writing: Inversion & Subjunctive Mood
description: Elevate your essay style by utilizing formal inversion structures and expressing hypothetical scenarios.

vocabulary.meaning: Bước chuyển đổi căn bản/Thay đổi tư duy
vocabulary.example: The rise of generative AI represents a paradigm shift in education.
Critical thinking is indispensable for academic writing.
Measures were taken to ameliorate learning conditions.

grammar.point: Inversion with Negative Adverbials & Subjunctive Mood
grammar.explanation: Đảo ngữ dùng để nhấn mạnh mức độ quan trọng. Câu giả định (Subjunctive Mood) dùng sau các động từ đề xuất, yêu cầu (demand, suggest, recommend).
structures: Inversion: Negative Word + Auxiliary Verb + S + Verb (Not only is AI powerful, but it also adapts to learners.)
Subjunctive: S1 + recommend/suggest + that + S2 + V (bare-infinitive) (I suggest that he study advanced grammar.)

reading.title: The Paradigm Shift in Modern Pedagogy
reading.content: Rarely has technology disrupted traditional educational models as profoundly as artificial intelligence. Under the old paradigm, students progressed at a uniform speed, regardless of individual comprehension deficits or acceleration capabilities. The incorporation of adaptive learning platforms represents a major step to ameliorate these issues. It is crucial that the educator remain a supervisor who guides critical thinking, rather than a mere broadcaster of information. Only when human mentorship and AI-driven personalization are combined can we truly achieve an indispensable learning environment.

questions.question: What is the author's suggestion regarding the role of the educator?
options: To broadcast as much information as possible
To guide critical thinking as a supervisor
To let AI replace teachers completely
To stick to traditional uniform progression
questions.answer: To guide critical thinking as a supervisor

questions.question: Which word is synonymous with 'essential' or 'absolutely necessary' in the text?

essayPrompt: Write an argumentative essay (200-250 words) on how artificial intelligence is changing the educational landscape. Use at least one inversion structure and one subjunctive mood structure.
